current_claim: H-JEPA dynamically grounds relocated physical targets from RGB when target is within camera frustum
caveat: Evaluated with verified camera visibility (visible_pixels >= 15); fails if target is placed behind robot without search policy.

current_claim: Changing task token under fixed RGB observation fails to redirect goal vector toward new target
caveat: Demonstrates that visual grounding requires visual saliency evidence matching the token; agent does not execute a blind feedforward semantic map.

current_claim: Disagreement between categorical task token and visual target causes significant performance degradation
caveat: Proves causal interaction between visual encoder features and task token embedding in infer_goal_vec.

current_claim: Handwritten controller goal memory provides no unique spatial information over pure visual grounding
caveat: Goal memory is a Python controller heuristic in model_wrappers.py; zero learned recurrent neural parameters in HJEPAModel.

current_claim: C1 8D linear subspace is non-selective for visual goal grounding; representation remains an unresolved hypothesis
caveat: Random 8D patching achieves higher donor cosine (0.9854 vs 0.9779) and equivalent rescue (90.9% vs 93.3%); does not prove a diffuse population code.

current_claim: Prospective collision head provides no closed-loop collision rate reduction over a disabled head
caveat: Intact, shuffled, and disabled heads yield identical 70% collision rates; empirical soft penalty is not a formal Control Barrier Function; clustered bootstrap AUROC CI is [0.5, 1.0].

current_claim: K=5 macro rollouts beat random candidate selection but do not outperform recursive 1-step micro planning
caveat: Macro beats random candidate selection (p=0.0117), but closed-loop difference vs 1-step micro lookahead is non-significant.

current_claim: Visual encoder preserves global co-rotation but lacks steerable egocentric group-equivariant representations
caveat: Behavioral retention under global arena rotation arises from preserved camera viewpoint, not group-equivariant CNN kernels.
